name: Maryland

teen.supervisedHours: 60 hours, including 10 at night (night = 30 minutes before sunset to 30 minutes after sunrise)
teen.holdPermit: 9 months under 18 (also 18 without a diploma); 3 months at 18 with diploma and at 19-24; 45 days at 25+. A moving violation or PBJ resets it to 9 months from that date.
teen.nightLimit: Provisional under 18: no driving midnight to 5 a.m. without a qualified supervising driver, except to or from work, school activity, organized volunteer program or athletic event/training
teen.passengerLimit: Provisional under 18: first 151 days no passengers under 18 other than immediate family unless a qualified supervising driver is present
teen.phone: Learner and provisional under 18: no wireless device at all, hands-free included, except 911. All drivers: hand-held use banned (primary offense).

notes: Supervising driver: 21 or older, licensed at least 3 years, in the front passenger seat with no other front-seat occupant (front-seat detail from a secondary source).
Knowledge test 25 questions, 22 correct to pass (88 percent): secondary sources only; one says the 10 sign questions must all be correct (not used).
Driver education: 30 hours classroom and 6 hours behind the wheel (MVA).
Move Over: since Oct 1, 2022 applies to any stopped vehicle showing hazard lights, flares or cones.
School bus: on a divided highway with a median only traffic following the bus must stop (Patch, possibly dated).
Handbook PDF URL not found within the search budget. Third-party sites mention a Spanish edition (DL-002); not confirmed on mva.maryland.gov.
Whether the knowledge test is offered in Spanish was not confirmed.
